response: This site is a demo version of the SmartChatbot platform 🤖. It’s designed to show how easily a bot can learn about any company once connected to its JSON file.
semantic_summary: Explains that this chatbot can be adapted to represent any company's site.

connected_responses.text: It’s built to adapt to each client’s brand and site data automatically.

next_responses.text: Yep! Each client’s bot loads its own companyTopics JSON file.
That means setup takes minutes, not weeks 🚀

connected_responses.text: It currently runs in demo mode without a live company file connected.

next_responses.text: Once a client file is added, I’ll know everything about their site.
That’s how I’ll handle real product and support questions soon.

connected_responses.text: Would you like me to explain how it connects to a real company site?

next_responses.text: It reads from a companyTopics JSON file stored under /data/knowledge.
That file includes company name, services, FAQs, and custom responses.

connected_responses.text: Each bot you sell will have its own companyTopics folder.

next_responses.text: So no company data overlaps — every bot stays unique 🧩
That keeps client data completely separated and secure 🔒

connected_responses.text: When a real site file is connected, I’ll describe their team, services, and contact info.

next_responses.text: That’s what makes me fully brand-adaptable 🤖
Each site’s tone can even be customized — friendly, formal, or playful.

connected_responses.text: Would you like a short example of what I’d say for a real client?

next_responses.text: For example: 'Welcome to 4Serve — your local chef-made meal platform 🍽️'
That’s just a mockup of what I’d say once linked to a site.json.

connected_responses.text: Once a site file is linked, I can also handle FAQs and support requests.

next_responses.text: So customers get fast, on-brand answers 24/7.
And you won’t need to retrain me — just upload the new file.

connected_responses.text: Would you like to learn how I’m customized per client?

next_responses.text: Each bot loads its own logic and companyTopics folder during setup.
That’s what lets me talk about each client’s services accurately.
